values.note: 2026 season: standard primitive sites $30, electric sites (30 and 50 amp) $50, group sites from $80, cabins $100; daily docking pass $20. Rates cover 2 adults, 2 children, 2 pets and 1 vehicle; each extra adult or child $5, pet $3, vehicle $10. Payment due in full at reservation; cancellations 14+ days out refunded less a $15 processing fee.

values.note: Booked online through Campground Reservations (Good Sam's booking engine), linked from the tribal campgrounds' site: 'available for online reservations: from January 4 at 10:00 AM MDT to September 30 at 08:00 PM MDT'. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon; the gate is closed 10 pm to 6 am (walk-in access only).

note: Blackfeet Tribal campground on Duck Lake on the Blackfeet Reservation near the Canadian border, 12.4 miles from Glacier's St. Mary entrance. Cabins and boat docking too. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the tribal campgrounds' site (2026 season): $30 primitive / $50 electric, 30- and 50-amp sites, reservable online. Added extras (adult/child $5, pet $3, vehicle $10), wifi, porta potties, the Campground Reservations booking link and its Jan 4 - Sep 30 online window. Not stated: season dates, site count, rig lengths, water/sewer, showers. Phone 406-338-4557 confirmed by the booking engine. Note trimmed of restated rates/booking.
